A '''museum''' on [[Triffis/Legends|Triffis]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Triffian/Legends|Triffian]] [[Eelen Li]] had a collection of ancient artifacts related to the Triffian [[Species/Legends|species]]. While serving as a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] from the planet in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Li presented a [[Unidentified Triffian carving|carving]] from the museum to Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] as a gift. Palpatine displayed the piece in his [[Palpatine's apartment/Legends|apartment suite]].
